meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装好后为 NanoClaw 加装 WhatsApp 频道：复制并注册 Baileys 适配器、安装依赖、构建，再用手机扫码或配对码关联设备，之后即可收发 WhatsApp 消息。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 频道时触发。安装前它会先问你用专用号还是你日常在用的号码，选后者会先给出封号风险提示。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 频道
say.note: 先问号码类型，再复制适配器、装依赖、构建

say.text: 用配对码方式关联，我的号码是 14155551234
say.note: 终端出 8 位码，在手机 WhatsApp 里输入

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw gains a WhatsApp channel: it copies and registers the Baileys adapter, installs pinned deps, builds, then links your phone by QR code or pairing code so the bot can send and receive WhatsApp messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw. Before installing, it asks for a dedicated or everyday number and warns about the ban risk of the latter.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Asks number type, then copies adapter, installs deps, builds

say_en.text: Link with a pairing code, my number is 14155551234
say_en.note: Terminal shows an 8-character code to type on your phone
Writes ASSISTANT_NAME to .env, used as the outbound prefix
